what: Every Mac measurement of this lane ran at a load average of 17 to 100 (other lanes' daemons, builds and revision tests): the same series gave a body edit then run of 57, 98, 104 and 148 ms at the median, with single runs of 7 to 15 s. The medians of blaze under the launcher, blaze today and Relax overlap there.
cost: four series that cannot rank the three ways; the comparison between the launcher and today's path rests on the VM, and Relax was never measured on a quiet machine
cause: one machine for every lane's builds and for the measurements a claim rests on
workaround: interleaved rounds (one of each way a round), and the quiet VM for the blaze-against-blaze rows
